summary.headline: Cloud Omens and Lunar Prognostications
summary.text: Chapter XVIII, “Observation concerning clouds,” interprets cloud height, mountain formations, mist, frost, and dew as omens of weather and wind. A new lunar prognostication method attributed to Melampus begins with the Moon in Aries, earthquakes, thunderbolts, and fruit scarcity.
